idea-plugin.name: Bracket Pair Guides
idea-plugin.description:
Active bracket-pair guides for JetBrains IDEs.

Bracket Pair Guides colors matched opening and closing tokens by nesting depth, then draws one focused path for the innermost pair containing the primary caret.

  • Follow the containing pair with a horizontal or multiline guide.
  • Use a customizable six-level repeating bracket palette.
  • Reuse the brace rules registered by each installed language plugin.
  • Optionally emphasize active endpoints with a border or background.
  • Suppress IntelliJ's competing matched-brace colors by default.
  • Enable or disable installed matcher-capable language families.

Recognition follows syntax tokens and the brace matcher provided by each installed language plugin rather than guessing from raw characters. Exact language and bracket support therefore depends on that plugin.

Verified with current IntelliJ IDEA, Android Studio, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, RubyMine, RustRover, and DataGrip releases.

Configure the plugin under Settings | Editor | Bracket Pair Guides. Requires IntelliJ Platform 2024.1 or newer.
